answer.answer: What changed: In the supplied record, Atlas Runner's supported concurrency changed once. Version 1.0 supported up to 8 concurrent jobs (atlas-release-1), and version 1.1 raised that limit from 8 to 16 concurrent jobs (atlas-release-2). Both snapshots belong to the same subject (subject_id: atlas-runner) and release lineage (lineage_id: atlas-release), so this is a versioned progression rather than a conflict between distinct entities. What is current now: Per the latest supplied snapshot (the 1.1 release notes), Atlas Runner supports up to 16 concurrent jobs; because no snapshot for any version after 1.1 is provided, 16 is the current figure only as of the latest available evidence. What remains historically valid: The 8-concurrent-job figure remains valid as an accurate description of version 1.0, superseded for subsequent versions by the 1.1 change. What is unresolved: The sources do not cover any release after 1.1, so later changes to the limit cannot be ruled in or out; nor do they specify whether the limit is a hard cap or a configurable default.
